source: docs/IMAGE-PLAN.md (2026-10-01), sections 2, 3, 7 and 9; written by the wf4 plan stage with tmp/wf4/plan/write-plans.mjs
about: tools/fal-gen.mjs reads defaults.model, defaults.style (appended to every prompt that is not an edit), defaults.input, defaults.cutoutModel, defaults.cutoutInput and images[]: id, prompt, model, editFrom, input, cutout, role, alt, usedFor, reuse, rejectReason. Every other field is for people and the later stages; fal-gen ignores it.
An entry with "reuse" is never generated (0 calls). A non-reuse entry costs 1 call (generation or Kontext edit) plus 1 birefnet call when cutout is true.
defaults.editModel and defaults.editInput are NOT read by fal-gen: every edit entry sets "model" and "input" itself (H3 does).

fal-gen reads editFrom BEFORE its --dry branch, so a --dry run of the whole plan stops with ENOENT at H3 until assets/generated/H3-src.jpg exists. Dry-run the rest with --only, or after H3-src is made.

Reserve calls are NOT entries: they are the "reserve" and "fix" fields. A fix is applied by editing that entry in place (fix.how) and running fal-gen --only <id> --force <id>; the rejected file is archived under assets/generated/rejected/.
cutoutInput is the validated fal-one.mjs setting (General Use (Heavy), 2048x2048, png) that made the accepted H1 and toolcheck cut-outs; IMAGE-PLAN 3.1 wrote {} (provider defaults, untested here).

budget.whyReserveDiffers: H1 fix and H3 retry each need a birefnet call beside the Kontext call (fal-gen runs the cut-out with every cutout:true entry): +1 each over IMAGE-PLAN 9
